# Oasis Volleyball Club

> Volleyball club in Abu Dhabi, UAE, for adults and children. Mixed social games every Monday and Friday, a competitive women's team in the UAE National League, private coaching, and kids' school programmes from age 5 (coming soon). All nationalities and levels welcome.

## Mixed social games (men and women, ages 16+, beginners welcome)
- Monday, 8-10 pm: ICS Khalidiya, Abu Dhabi. Some free parking in front of the school; paid street parking beside it.
- Friday, 9-11 pm: Raha International School, Khalifa City Campus. Bring Emirates ID for the gate (digital ID is fine).
- 35 AED per game. Sign up and pay at least 24 hours ahead: https://volleyball-signup.vercel.app
- Game announcements: Mixed Social Games WhatsApp group https://chat.whatsapp.com/GD7I8r3fnTNLAEN6s6q2b7

## Ladies-only games
- About once a month, women of all levels, 70 AED.
- Invitations are shared in the Ladies Only WhatsApp group: https://chat.whatsapp.com/EtNuUqPx47xL4fgCQy8T78

## Women's team
Full page: https://www.oasisvolleyballclub.com/womens-volleyball-abu-dhabi
- Training Tuesday 8-10 pm at Sports Hub Khalidiya (free parking) and Thursday 8-10 pm at British International School Abu Dhabi (BISAD).
- Ages 18+, basic playing skills needed. First trial session is free.
- Professional coach who also coaches the men's and women's teams at NYU.
- Prices: 100 AED per session; 500 AED per calendar month; 3,000 AED for the full season (September 1 to June 15, 64 sessions, prorated for late joiners).
- Players can be selected for the UAE National League roster (14 places, chosen by the coach), friendly games and tournaments in Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Entry fees covered for at least 4 games per player per season.
- Club Adidas kit required (about 200-300 AED).

## Other
- Private coaching: 500 AED per hour plus gym cost.
- Club jerseys for anyone: Adidas kit, or locally printed jersey for 45 AED.
- Kids' programmes for boys and girls from age 5 at Abu Dhabi schools: coming soon.
- Sponsorship: email for the proposal. Past partners include GoodEats Nutrition, BOLD Hydration and Organic Shop.
